scope: 525 HEROES_DB universes, mode probes without a concrete scene; exact source scenes and continuity exclusions are tested separately
mechanismGeometry: authored scene-specific procedural geometry; physical function and timing are adaptations
preservationEvidence: stage-baseline.json contains all41 previous definitions and two recorder hashes per profile

profiles.sourceWork: Metal Gear Solid (1998) — Shadow Moses heliport
profiles.sourceScene: Shadow Moses — héliport, projecteurs du périmètre de MGS 1998
profiles.sceneEvidence: The heliport infiltration has moving searchlights. Two fixed-height lighting fixtures scan only their distant backdrop sectors; they never detect actors, raise an alert or deal damage.

profiles.sourceWork: Metal Gear Solid (1998) — Shadow Moses cargo dock
profiles.sourceScene: Shadow Moses — quai de chargement, ascenseur à câbles de l’introduction
profiles.sceneEvidence: Snake reaches the heliport by the cargo-dock elevator in the opening infiltration. An empty distant freight platform moves on its guides; it is not a playable platform or route.

profiles.sourceWork: Guilty Gear XX — Zepp military airship setting
profiles.sourceScene: Zepp — dirigeable militaire de Guilty Gear XX, hélices latérales
profiles.sceneEvidence: Zepp is the airborne military nation associated with Potemkin. The propeller housings interpret its airship machinery; this is authored mechanical staging, not a verified original stage loop.

profiles.sourceWork: Guilty Gear XX — May Ship, Jellyfish Pirates
profiles.sourceScene: May Ship — treuil d’ancre du navire des Jellyfish Pirates, version XX
profiles.sceneEvidence: May belongs to the Jellyfish Pirates and uses an anchor. The shipboard drum, rope and suspended anchor are an explicit mechanical adaptation of that nautical setting; no anchor attacks actors.

profiles.sourceWork: Mass Effect (2007) — Normandy SR-1 galaxy map
profiles.sourceScene: Normandy SR-1 — carte galactique holographique du pont de navigation
profiles.sceneEvidence: The SR-1 navigation deck has a projected galaxy map. Fixed star clusters rotate above its projector; the display changes no destination, mission, squad state or simulation clock.

profiles.sourceWork: Mass Effect (2007) — Citadel Presidium transit
profiles.sourceScene: Citadelle — Presidium, voies aériennes des skycars sous le ciel artificiel
profiles.sceneEvidence: Skycars travel through the Citadel’s urban space beneath the artificial sky. Small cars follow two background transit lanes without becoming targets, vehicles or collision objects.

profiles.sourceWork: Dead Space (2008) — USG Ishimura engineering centrifuge
profiles.sourceScene: USG Ishimura — ingénierie, bras de la centrifugeuse
profiles.sceneEvidence: The engineering chapter includes a large rotating centrifuge. Its projected arms remain inside a distant circular housing; the game receives no zero-gravity field, sweep hazard or collision.

profiles.sourceWork: Dead Space (2008) — USG Ishimura tram repair and transit
profiles.sourceScene: USG Ishimura — station du tram, voiture et bras d’arrimage
profiles.sceneEvidence: The opening repair sequence reconnects the Ishimura tram using mechanical arms. A background car approaches a stop and the coupling arms pivot; no repair objective or ride is added.

profiles.sourceWork: Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance (2013) — R-04 World Marshal headquarters
profiles.sourceScene: Denver — World Marshal R-04, monte-charge du siège
profiles.sceneEvidence: Raiden traverses the World Marshal headquarters and rides freight elevators in R-04. This empty shaft’s counterweight and platform move only in the background, with no combat spawning.

profiles.sourceWork: Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance (2013) — R-01 Abkhazia refinery
profiles.sourceScene: Abkhazia — raffinerie R-01, compresseurs sur les conduites
profiles.sceneEvidence: The R-01 refinery is the industrial setting of the Mistral encounter. Crank-driven compressors are an authored interpretation of its process machinery, not a claim that these exact pistons appear in a source frame.

profiles.sourceWork: Tekken 8 — Urban Square
profiles.sourceScene: Urban Square — taxis derrière les barrières de la place de Tekken 8
profiles.sceneEvidence: Urban Square is a New York-inspired street stage with urban traffic. Yellow-cab silhouettes and rotating wheels follow the fenced backdrop road; no vehicle enters or strikes the combat lane.

profiles.sourceWork: Tekken 4 — Airport
profiles.sourceScene: Airport de Tekken 4 — turbine d’un avion stationné sur le parking arrière
profiles.sceneEvidence: The official Tekken 4 stage page describes parked aircraft and their wheels. The fuselage and wheels stay fixed here; only the engine fan turns as an authored mechanical interpretation, not a verified original idle loop.

profiles.sourceWork: Rayman 3: Hoodlum Havoc (2003) — Hoodlum Headquarters
profiles.sourceScene: Rayman 3 — Hoodlum Headquarters, convoyeur de l’usine
profiles.sceneEvidence: Hoodlum Headquarters is the industrial Hoodlum factory. Small closed crates advance around a chain conveyor behind a fixed guard; the belt cannot carry characters or create enemies.

profiles.sourceWork: Rayman Legends (2013) — 20,000 Lums Under the Sea
profiles.sourceScene: Rayman Legends — 20 000 Lums Under the Sea, scanner de la base sous-marine
profiles.sceneEvidence: The undersea world uses stealth, underwater bases and security searchlights. A sealed window scanner sweeps a backdrop chamber only; it has no detection callback, alarm or attack.

profiles.sourceWork: Soulcalibur II (2002/2003) — Village of the Wind
profiles.sourceScene: Village of the Wind — moulin de Talim dans Soulcalibur II
profiles.sceneEvidence: The licensed Piggyback guide identifies Chapter 4-2 Windmill as the Village of the Wind stage. Rotating wooden sails drive the small hub gear; their timing and dimensions are authored, with no change to arena bounds.

profiles.sourceWork: Soulcalibur VI — Indian Port: Impending Storm
profiles.sourceScene: Indian Port — Impending Storm de Soulcalibur VI, embarcations amarrées
profiles.sceneEvidence: Indian Port is a coastal harbor stage with boats and moorings. Tethered hulls rock on the background water while their lines remain attached; no storm hazard or moving combat floor is introduced.

profiles.sourceWork: NieR:Automata (2017) — Amusement Park
profiles.sourceScene: NieR Automata — Amusement Park, manège circulaire des machines
profiles.sceneEvidence: Automata’s amusement park contains mechanical rides and a carousel. Rotating seats, suspension rods and the canopy refer to that location, without summoning machine enemies or importing Replicant locations.

profiles.sourceWork: NieR:Automata (2017) — Abandoned Factory
profiles.sourceScene: NieR Automata — usine abandonnée, chaîne de production du plan arrière
profiles.sceneEvidence: The abandoned factory contains industrial production lines and robotic machinery. Workpieces move beneath a synchronized mechanical arm on a distant belt, without spawning units or altering collision.

profiles.sourceWork: Dark Souls (2011) — Firelink Shrine / Undead Parish elevator
profiles.sourceScene: Firelink Shrine de Dark Souls 2011 — ascenseur du raccourci vers Undead Parish
profiles.sceneEvidence: The original Firelink Shrine connects to Undead Parish by paired elevators. Counterbalanced empty platforms move inside the distant stone shaft; no shortcut is unlocked and actors cannot ride them.

profiles.sourceWork: Dark Souls (2011) — Anor Londo rotating staircase tower
profiles.sourceScene: Anor Londo de Dark Souls 2011 — tour de l’escalier tournant
profiles.sceneEvidence: The Anor Londo tower changes the orientation and height of its spiral stairway. A small architectural model turns behind the arena; the playable topology and bridges never move.

profiles.sourceWork: Devil May Cry 3 (2005) — Temen-ni-gru, Gears of Madness
profiles.sourceScene: Temen-ni-gru — Gears of Madness de Devil May Cry 3, train d’engrenages
profiles.sceneEvidence: Gears of Madness is a mechanical room of Temen-ni-gru. Three different-size gears counter-rotate on the back wall, with no platform, trap, enemy or progression effect.

profiles.sourceWork: Devil May Cry 4 (2008) — Fortuna Gyro Blade mechanism
profiles.sourceScene: Fortuna — Gyro Blade de Devil May Cry 4 dans son support arrière
profiles.sceneEvidence: Nero activates Gyro Blades as rotating mechanical puzzle objects in Fortuna. This decorative specimen stays inside its background support: it never launches, cuts, collides or interacts with a character.

profiles.sourceWork: Final Fantasy VIII (1999) — mobile Balamb Garden
profiles.sourceScene: Balamb Garden — anneaux et stabilisateurs du Garden en vol
profiles.sceneEvidence: Balamb Garden becomes mobile after its MD-level systems activate. A distant architectural silhouette and rotating ring describe that mode; neither the scene camera nor any combat platform flies.

profiles.sourceWork: Final Fantasy VIII (1999) — D-District Prison
profiles.sourceScene: D-District Prison — tour à vis et niveaux du bloc cellulaire
profiles.sceneEvidence: D-District Prison has cylindrical towers and a screw-like raising mechanism. Window bands orbit a distant tower while its base moves slightly on the helix; no cell, prisoner or gameplay floor moves.
